comment: The configOptions of one session/new reply, recorded verbatim from the installed DSH CLI 0.2.1-rc.2 ACP agent on 2026-10-29 (initialize and session/new only; no prompt was sent). The model selector names the provider in each option value and in its group key. The initialize reply of the same session reported authMethods: [] and no account or balance field.

options.name: Off
options.description: Use for simple tasks that do not need reasoning.

options.name: Low
options.description: Prefer for routine or latency-sensitive tasks.

options.name: High
options.description: The default balance for most tasks.

options.name: Max
options.description: Reserve for the hardest quality-first tasks.
